items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yes the one with 'Liza' in it?

ctx.x: they had a show. Duke Ellington got that too. That job, 'Show Girl' I think the name of it.
Yes the one with 'Liza' in it?
Yes. But anyway, it was a Ziegfeld show. And Ziegfeld, we made an audition you know, through Rockwell and that bunch. We made an audition and boy, Ziegfeld walked out on us.
